user.title: Set up Music Manager
user.description: The card and connector are installed together. The dashboard resource is registered automatically; reload Home Assistant afterwards. Start with radio only or select the existing Music Assistant connection for Apple Music. Then open Configure to assign personal accounts.

error.cannot_connect: Music Assistant is unavailable or this connection cannot read users.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Music Manager is already configured. Open Configure to manage account assignments.
abort.music_assistant_missing: Set up the official Music Assistant integration first.

init.title: Configuration overview

add.title: Assign personal Apple Music account
add.description: 1 HA user = 1 MA user = 1 Apple Music provider instance. Select your existing active MA user or administrator account. In Music Assistant → Settings → User management → your user → Music sources, select exactly the assigned Apple Music instance. Your administrator role is preserved. Then select the three matching entries.

data.provider_id: Apple Music account in Music Assistant

remove.title: Remove assignment
remove.description: The selected HA user loses Apple Music access through this card. Radio favorites remain available.

connect.title: Connect Music Assistant
connect.description: Select the existing Music Assistant connection. Switching to another connection or to radio only clears Apple Music account assignments so they can be set up again. Radio favorites are preserved.

alarm.title: Add alarm
alarm.description: Add separate alarms for each person, including multiple alarms per person. The suggested ID is unused; you can enter your own unique ID. Choose the owner whose favorites and Apple Music account are used and their Sonos speaker. Use the same ID in the alarm row and automation. Existing alarms are preserved; use Edit to change them.

edit.title: Edit user assignment
edit.description: Select an existing assignment. Its saved values are prefilled in the next step.

alarm_edit.title: Edit alarm
alarm_edit.description: Select an existing alarm. Its user and Sonos speaker are prefilled in the next step. The alarm ID is preserved.

account_edit.title: Edit user assignment
account_edit.description: The saved assignment is prefilled. Its HA user is fixed. Change the Music Assistant and Apple Music account as needed. A choice marked with ⚠ is currently unavailable and must be replaced.

data.provider_id: Apple Music account in Music Assistant

alarm_update.title: Edit alarm
alarm_update.description: The saved user and Sonos speaker are prefilled. The alarm ID is fixed so the card and automation still reference the same alarm. A choice marked with ⚠ is currently unavailable and must be replaced.

speaker_users.title: Speaker selection
speaker_users.description: These users can change the speaker in the Music Manager card. Each user has a saved selection. Initially, uniquely named active HA users Vera and Manuel are selected. Other users use the configured speaker. Existing HA permissions still apply.

error.invalid_account: Select valid entries from the lists.
error.duplicate_account: This MA user or Apple Music instance is already assigned to another HA user.
error.account_filter: In Music Assistant → Settings → User management → your user → Music sources, select exactly the assigned Apple Music source. This also applies to administrators; keep the existing role.
error.cannot_connect: Music Assistant is unavailable or this connection cannot read users.
error.account_disabled: The MA account must be active with the user or administrator role. Reload the selection and check the account in Music Assistant.
error.provider_unavailable: The selected Apple Music account is no longer available. Check its login in Music Assistant and reload the selection.
error.invalid_alarm: Check the ID (a-z, 0-9, underscore), owner, Apple Music assignment and speaker permissions.
error.duplicate_alarm: This alarm ID is already in use. Choose a different ID for the new alarm or edit the existing alarm using the pencil icon.

abort.accounts_missing: Add an Apple Music provider instance and an active user or administrator account in Music Assistant first.
abort.cannot_connect: Music Assistant is unavailable or this connection cannot read users.
abort.no_accounts: No accounts have been assigned yet.
abort.music_assistant_missing: First connect Music Assistant under Configure → Music Assistant connection. Radio already works.
abort.invalid_account: The selected user assignment no longer exists. Reopen the configuration.
